newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki bourse fines Amer FIM 100,000.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki bourse fines Amer FIM 100,000.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange said in a statement on Monday its disciplinary committee had fined sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy 100,000 markka ($22,000) for not informing quickly enough about changes in the company's result.

"Information about a change in the result must be made public without undue delay when the change has become apparent and when the company's board has been informed," the bourse said, quoting the disciplinary committee's ruling.
In Amer's case, the board became aware on April 25 that the result outlook had changed, but this information was published only on June 6, the bourse said.
"The profit warning should have been published immediately after the April 25, 1996 board meeting and not only on June 6 when the board dealt with the first 1996 interim report," it said.
In addition to the fine, the disciplinary committee also issued a formal warning to Amer, the bourse said.
The disciplinary committee can hand out fines up to 500,000 markka, it added.
